verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents ACID transactions spanning graph, vector, and text data in one transaction, and durable BM25 text indexes in the same engine with no separate stores to synchronize. Together these imply that committed writes are consistently reflected in search, but the evidence never describes upsert or delete operations, index refresh latency, or explicit freshness semantics. Missing for 10: documented upsert/delete APIs, explicit index freshness/visibility timing (e.g. whether ANN index updates are immediate), consistency behavior under continuous writes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
